summary.en: Into one layer of an overview: the other layers are pushed away and fade while the focus layer grows into its detail layout, a loop pill becoming a circle.
summary.zh: 放大总图的某一层：其他层被推开淡出，焦点层长成细节布局，循环药丸变成圆。

fits: Going from a system map into one part, and back.
notFor: Camera moves through a scene; zooming into a picture or a screenshot.

intent.en: Keep the viewer sure which overview cell became which detail part.
intent.zh: 让观众确定总图里的哪一格变成了细节里的哪个部件。

content.en: An overview with a focus layer, and the detail layout of its parts.
content.zh: 带焦点层的总图，以及它的部件在细节里的布局。

fits.zh: 从系统总图进入某一部分，再回来。

notFor.zh: 镜头在场景里移动；放大图片或截图。

en: Keep the overview's left-to-right order in the detail so no part crosses another.
The layers below the focus fade at once (0.3 s), or they cross the presenter reserve as they grow.
zh: 细节里保持总图的左右顺序，部件不交叉。
焦点下面的层要马上淡出（0.3 秒），否则放大时会压到主讲人预留区。
